Living well

A Place for Everything

An easier room begins with understanding what you reach for.

Illustrative concept

Design from the inside out.

List the things you use daily before deciding where cupboards go. Keep preparation tools near the work surface and occasional pieces away from the busiest routes.

Drawers, tall storage and corner fittings solve different problems. Consider how you reach, bend and move rather than filling every available space with a mechanism. Confirm fit and load requirements when the cabinetry is specified.
